module.title: Demo Data - Musterkraftwerke GmbH (Manufacturing, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Accounting, CRM, Projects, Helpdesk)
module.summary: ERP demo for a German manufacturer of made-to-measure combined heat and power plants (CHP/BHKW): own company with the German chart of accounts (SKR04), component and finished-goods catalog, bills of materials, draft manufacturing orders, procurement, stock, a CRM pipeline, project delivery, posted customer/vendor invoices and after-sales service tickets.
module.description: Sample demo-data module for Musterkraftwerke GmbH (Musterstadt, Thuringia, Germany), a manufacturer of combined heat and power plants (Blockheizkraftwerke, BHKW) from 20 to 530 kW el., made to measure for agriculture, municipalities and industry. It creates 1 new company including the German chart of accounts (l10n_de, SKR04), 8 contacts (component suppliers and business customers), 13 products (gas engines, generators, heat exchangers, control cabinets, frames and acoustic enclosures as components; three finished CHP units; commissioning, maintenance and remote-monitoring services), 3 bills of materials, 3 draft manufacturing orders, 4 CRM opportunities, 3 purchase orders, stock for 8 products, 3 posted invoices/bills (posted in the post_init_hook), 4 helpdesk tickets, 3 quotation templates, 1 quotation, 2 example sales orders and 2 delivery projects with tasks.
